title: Let's build a Chatbot - MCP Servers (Part 12)

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to part 12 of Let's Bidder Chatbots in C-sharp using Microsoft 18 framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到使用 C# 與 Microsoft Agent Framework 打造聊天機器人的第十二部分。

cues.en: Today we're going to add something that the real-life chatbots really don't have yet,
cues.zh: 今天要加入一項許多實際聊天機器人還沒有的功能，

cues.en: which is adding that the user can add their own MCP servers and thereby giving more tools to the AI.
cues.zh: 讓使用者自行新增 MCP 伺服器，提供更多工具給 AI。

cues.en: So we're going to do it anyway, and in the process, we might see why people are not adding it.
cues.zh: 我們會自己實作，也可能在過程中理解，為什麼其他產品沒有加入。

cues.en: So let's first look at the finalized version of this.
cues.zh: 先看完成後的版本。

cues.en: You can see over here there's an MCP server, but before we go into that, I made a chat
cues.zh: 可以看到這裡有 MCP Servers。不過在介紹之前，我先和系統進行了一段，

cues.en: with the system here, and this happened before I added any MCP servers or before the code was ready.
cues.zh: 對話，當時還沒加入任何 MCP 伺服器，相關程式碼也還沒完成。

cues.en: So I asked, what is Trello.net?
cues.zh: 我問：Trello.NET 是什麼？

cues.en: You might not know what that is, but it comes back here without any MCP servers and stuff and tells a little about its .net client.
cues.zh: 你可能不知道，但即使沒有 MCP，它也會介紹這個 .NET 用戶端。

cues.en: And I kind of know this .net client quite a lot because I'm the maintainer of this Trello.net, which is the REST-based API for Trello.
cues.zh: 而我很熟悉這個用戶端，因為我是 Trello.NET 的維護者，它是 Trello 的 REST API 用戶端。

cues.en: And Trello, if you don't know, is a Kanban board tool where you can collaborate, work, and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 如果不熟悉 Trello，它是一套看板工具，可以協作、管理工作等等。

cues.en: So it's essentially just an API that I've made, it's open source, public repo, and everything.
cues.zh: 因此這是我建立的 API 用戶端，開放原始碼，也有公開儲存庫。

cues.en: But since it knows it, why do we need an MCP server, or why do we feel there's a problem here?
cues.zh: 但既然模型知道，為什麼還需要 MCP？問題在哪裡？

cues.en: Well, I know this kind of well, and when it comes down and shows an example of how to do this, this is absolutely made-up stuff.
cues.zh: 因為我很熟悉它，當模型展示用法時，就知道這些內容完全是編造的。

cues.en: It is not the way it's done at all in the tool.
cues.zh: 這根本不是這套工具的使用方式。

cues.en: This call would not even compile, and most of it, the rest of it wouldn't either.
cues.zh: 這個呼叫甚至無法編譯，其他大部分內容也不行。

cues.en: So it makes sense that we should be able to add tools because not even a thing like Google
cues.zh: 所以能夠加入工具很合理。甚至 Google，

cues.en: Gemini, if I ask it, it knows a little more and can link to it and stuff.
cues.zh: Gemini 雖然知道更多，也能提供連結，

cues.en: But if I, again, ask it to show an example of doing something, it also makes it up.
cues.zh: 但再次要求提供實作範例，它一樣會編造。

cues.en: This cannot be done at all in the code.
cues.zh: 這種寫法在程式碼中完全不存在。

cues.en: It would break if you put this in.
cues.zh: 直接放進去就會出錯。

cues.en: Not even this can do it.
cues.zh: 連它也做不到。

cues.en: I tried to check GPT, it knows a little more, it seems, so it could actually do some of it.
cues.zh: 我試過 ChatGPT，它似乎知道更多，有些內容確實做得對。

cues.en: But again, imagine then if your implementation here was something that was a private repo
cues.zh: 但再想像，如果你使用的是私人儲存庫，

cues.en: and you had made an MCP server to tell about it.
cues.zh: 並為它建立了一個提供資訊的 MCP 伺服器。

cues.en: Because what I have done is I've made an MCP server for this, so it knows all the code.
cues.zh: 我正是為這套工具建立了 MCP，讓它能查詢所有程式碼。

cues.en: I have a separate video about that, if that is interesting, let me know and I will link to it.
cues.zh: 這部分有另外一支影片，有興趣可以告訴我，我會提供連結。

cues.en: But essentially, I just have made an MCP server that runs up on an Azure function, and it has this URL.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是建立一個執行在 Azure Functions 上的 MCP 伺服器，位址是這個 URL。

cues.en: And what I did in order to fix this problem that it just came up with random nonsense
cues.zh: 為了解決它隨便編造內容的問題，

cues.en: is that I gave the MCP, or the chatbot, the MCP server of Trello.NET Assistance, which is that URL up here.
cues.zh: 我把 Trello.NET Assistance 的 MCP 伺服器，也就是上面這個 URL，加入聊天機器人。

cues.en: This one doesn't need any headers, keys, and stuff, but it is built to be able to add stuff as well.
cues.zh: 這個服務不需要標頭或金鑰，但介面也支援額外設定，

cues.en: But I'm not using it in this case.
cues.zh: 只是這次不使用。

cues.en: It's made to have multiple servers, if needed.
cues.zh: 有需要時，也能加入多個伺服器。

cues.en: And when I put that tool in, I can again ask exactly the same question, and it picks up
cues.zh: 加入後，再問完全相同的問題，它會發現，

cues.en: that that tool has a getting started about what this is and how to start using it.
cues.zh: 工具裡有 Getting Started，說明這是什麼、如何開始使用。

cues.en: This is a very little thing about how to do things, and it can use that in order to make the right thing.
cues.zh: 這只是一份簡短入門，但足以讓模型採用正確做法。

cues.en: And in this case, it didn't make a big example.
cues.zh: 這次它沒有提供大型範例，

cues.en: So I asked the same question as I did with Google Gemini.
cues.zh: 所以我提出與 Gemini 相同的問題。

cues.en: Show me an example on how to add a card.
cues.zh: 請示範如何新增卡片。

cues.en: And it called another tool, and that tool gives back a lot of information.
cues.zh: 它呼叫另一個工具，而那個工具會回傳大量資訊。

cues.en: This is more or less public members, public properties, and all kinds of things in the tool.
cues.zh: 大致包含公開成員、公開屬性，以及工具的各種介面。

cues.en: Let's try and check it out here.
cues.zh: 實際看看。

cues.en: It's a big search result, and I give it back in an XML format style.
cues.zh: 這是一份大型搜尋結果，我用 XML 形式回傳。

cues.en: If we grab a quick one here, it's with a lot of spaces and stuff, but it will tell a lot
cues.zh: 隨便取一段，雖然有很多空白，但會詳細說明，

cues.en: about what each of the things are and how to use them in the system.
cues.zh: 各個項目是什麼，以及如何使用。

cues.en: And what it gives back is a perfect example on how to do it, how to make the Trello client,
cues.zh: 最後回傳了完全正確的範例，包括建立 TrelloClient，

cues.en: how to get the queue on board, how to get the list, and such things.
cues.zh: 取得看板、清單等等。

cues.en: So believe me, this is 100% correct code, while before it was just made-up code.
cues.zh: 相信我，這是百分之百正確的程式碼，而前面完全是編造的。

cues.en: I gave it another example and asked it.
cues.zh: 我也另外提出其他範例問題。

cues.en: This also shows that my tool is pretty expensive because it has some very big results back here.
cues.zh: 不過這也顯示，我的工具很花 Token，因為回傳結果非常大。

cues.en: And that we can see in that we're actually using quite a lot of tokens, 13,000 tokens input here.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這裡使用了約 13,000 個輸入 Token。

cues.en: And that might be one of the reasons why the big LLMs don't add tools like this, because
cues.zh: 這可能也是大型聊天服務不直接加入這種工具的原因之一，因為，

cues.en: they can't really control how much extra tokens you will end up using by putting them in.
cues.zh: 他們無法控制，使用者加入工具後會增加多少 Token。

cues.en: Some MCP tools cost almost nothing, but some tools cost more if they need to give back much information.
cues.zh: 有些 MCP 工具幾乎不花成本，但有些需要回傳很多資訊，就會很貴。

cues.en: So that might be one of the reasons.
cues.zh: 所以這可能是其中一個原因。

cues.en: But in our case, again, we want it, so let's have a look into how this code is made.
cues.zh: 不過這裡我們確實需要，接著看看程式碼如何實作。

cues.en: So let's jump over into Visual Studio.
cues.zh: 切換到 Visual Studio。

cues.en: So first up, we needed to have a place to put our MCP server, so we put that into the
cues.zh: 首先需要一個位置存放 MCP 伺服器設定，因此加入，

cues.en: user personalization that we did a few sessions ago.
cues.zh: 前幾個單元建立的 UserPersonalization。

cues.en: And we just make a list of MCP servers, and those MCP servers can use name, URL, and headers.
cues.zh: 新增 MCP Servers 清單，每個設定包含名稱、URL 與 Headers。

cues.en: We're not going to tackle OAuth in this scenario, and we're not going to tackle local tools, which you probably wouldn't put into a chatbot anyway.
cues.zh: 這次不處理 OAuth，也不處理本機工具，因為通常也不會放進這種聊天機器人。

cues.en: So we're keeping it fairly simple with no authentication or simple API key authentication.
cues.zh: 保持簡單，只支援無驗證或簡單 API 金鑰驗證。

cues.en: I have separate videos on this channel about MCP OAuth.
cues.zh: 頻道上有另外介紹 MCP OAuth 的影片。

cues.en: Needless to say, it's quite advanced how you actually do it.
cues.zh: 實際做起來確實比較進階。

cues.en: So we have the GUI, and the GUI for keeping it is up here.
cues.zh: 設定介面放在上面。

cues.en: And honestly, I haven't really looked at it too much.
cues.zh: 老實說，我沒有仔細研究它的每個細節。

cues.en: I made Codex make this.
cues.zh: 我是請 Codex 撰寫的。

cues.en: But essentially, it's just a button, and then a small div that you are being shown as a
cues.zh: 本質上就是一個按鈕，按下後顯示小型 div，

cues.en: dialog when we go in and click, do this.
cues.zh: 作為設定對話框。

cues.en: So it's a bunch of normal Blazor, nothing to do with AI, so we won't go through it too much here.
cues.zh: 都是一般 Blazor，和 AI 無關，因此不詳細逐行介紹。

cues.en: And the code behind it in order to save it, so we load the personalizations and put the data in, of course.
cues.zh: 背後則載入個人化設定、更新資料，再儲存。

cues.en: So this is all done by AI, and I haven't made any of it.
cues.zh: 這些都是 AI 完成的，我沒有親自撰寫。

cues.en: It's just simple things to do.
cues.zh: 因為只是簡單的基礎功能。

cues.en: The interesting part, of course, is that we want to have that being used.
cues.zh: 有趣的部分，當然是如何真正使用這些設定。

cues.en: And the way we do that is we use one more feature of Agent Framework Toolkit, which
cues.zh: 做法是使用 Agent Framework Toolkit 的另一項功能，

cues.en: is the tools area, and specifically the model context protocol tools area.
cues.zh: 也就是 Tools 區域，尤其 Model Context Protocol Tools。

cues.en: This is something that can give a new factory.
cues.zh: 它會提供新的 Factory。

cues.en: Just like we had the agent factory, we now also have an AI tool factory that can turn an MCP server into tools.
cues.zh: 就像 Agent Factory，現在還有 AIToolFactory，可以把 MCP 伺服器轉成工具。

cues.en: Because when we use Agent Framework, MCP servers are just tools like any other.
cues.zh: 因為在 Agent Framework 中，MCP 伺服器提供的就是一般工具。

cues.en: This one up here is just so we can put in the MCP servers to none when we run the first time, but nothing more than that.
cues.zh: 上面這段只是處理第一次執行、還沒有 MCP 設定的情況，沒有其他用途。

cues.en: And then we have the interesting code here.
cues.zh: 有趣的是下面這段。

cues.en: So we add one of these AI tools factories that we just dependency injected down in the service defaults.
cues.zh: 先注入 AIToolFactory，註冊位置在 ServiceDefaults。

cues.en: Then I have extracted the tools that were down here, the two tools we had up front, the image generation tool and the weather tool, and just made them into a list here
cues.zh: 接著把原本的圖像生成與天氣兩個工具抽出來，改成清單，

cues.en: because we wanted to add on the fly more tools.
cues.zh: 因為想在執行時繼續加入其他工具。

cues.en: Those more tools would come from each of the MCP servers we make, and that is done with
cues.zh: 其他工具來自使用者設定的各個 MCP 伺服器，透過，

cues.en: this method that we'll look at in one second, but it just gives us back a list of MCP clients.
cues.zh: 稍後會介紹的方法取得，回傳的是 MCP 用戶端連線清單。

cues.en: Because when we do this, and if we have multiple clients, we need to new up those clients.
cues.zh: 因為可能有多個伺服器，需要分別建立用戶端。

cues.en: And we can't just take the tools by themselves.
cues.zh: 不能只取出工具，就把用戶端丟掉。

cues.en: We need to keep these in memory while the calls are being made.
cues.zh: 呼叫過程中，需要把這些用戶端留在記憶體。

cues.en: We can't just discard them because if we do, the client will close the connection.
cues.zh: 不能直接釋放，否則連線就會關閉。

cues.en: And that's probably one of the other reasons why MCP, the real-life chatbots don't do this,
cues.zh: 這可能也是實際聊天服務沒有直接加入 MCP 的另一個原因，

cues.en: that it would need to keep a lot of clients in memory from all the different users across the globe that are using them.
cues.zh: 必須為全世界不同使用者，保留大量用戶端連線。

cues.en: And because it needs this persistent connection, it could be annoying for them.
cues.zh: 因為需要持續連線，可能會造成管理上的負擔。

cues.en: I'm just guessing here, but I could guess that that would be one of the problems.
cues.zh: 這只是我的猜測，但可能是問題之一。

cues.en: But for us, we are only one user here, or it might be internal usage.
cues.zh: 我們這裡只有一位使用者，或可能只是內部使用。

cues.en: But you need to be aware if there's multiple here.
cues.zh: 不過多使用者情況下，仍然要留意。

cues.en: But if we do this, we can get the tools.
cues.zh: 連線建立後，就能取得工具。

cues.en: And let's have a look at how we get the tools, which is very simple.
cues.zh: 取得方式非常簡單，看看程式。

cues.en: We just want a list of these MCP client tools.
cues.zh: 只需要一份 MCP Client Tools 清單。

cues.en: We get our personalization because that's where our MCP servers are.
cues.zh: 先取得個人化設定，因為 MCP 伺服器設定放在那裡。

cues.en: And for each of them, we just call this factory and say, get tools from remote MCP.
cues.zh: 針對每個伺服器，呼叫 Factory 的 GetToolsFromRemoteMcp。

cues.en: So behind the scenes, it's using the model context protocol NuGet packets that exist.
cues.zh: 背後使用現有的 ModelContextProtocol NuGet 套件。

cues.en: And turn them into tools, because the tools that you get out of an MCP server is actually just a variant of the AI tools that we normally get.
cues.zh: 再把結果轉成工具，因為 MCP 伺服器的工具，其實就是一般 AITool 的變體。

cues.en: We just send the URL and the headers in and return these connections to MCP clients.
cues.zh: 傳入 URL 與 Headers，再回傳 MCP 用戶端連線。

cues.en: And when we do that, we can get the tools.
cues.zh: 如此就可以取得工具。

cues.en: And we just now have some more tools.
cues.zh: 現在就多了更多工具。

cues.en: In my case, if we set a breakpoint here and run.
cues.zh: 在這裡設中斷點，再執行。

cues.en: So let's quickly start a new one here and say, what is Trello.net?
cues.zh: 快速開一段新對話，詢問 Trello.NET 是什麼。

cues.en: And of course, you can do this for any other thing.
cues.zh: 當然，也可以用其他服務。

cues.en: It's just, this is a convenient MCP server for me to test.
cues.zh: 只是這個 MCP 方便我測試。

cues.en: So in one second, we should hopefully get this breakpoint.
cues.zh: 稍後應該會命中中斷點。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: So it made the connection to the MCP, and it gave back one of these clients that have the MCP client that we need to keep in memory.
cues.zh: 它建立了 MCP 連線，回傳包含 MCP Client 的物件，而這個 Client 必須留在記憶體中。

cues.en: And in my case, it has two tools.
cues.zh: 這個伺服器有兩個工具。

cues.en: It had a tool that's called Getting Started.
cues.zh: 一個叫 Getting Started，

cues.en: And it has a tool that's called Trello.net Code Assistance.
cues.zh: 另一個叫 Trello.NET Code Assistance。

cues.en: And if we look at those tools, we can go in and check what they can do and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 查看工具，可以檢查各自的能力與定義。

cues.en: So this takes an input as a question, and we get that.
cues.zh: 這個工具接收問題作為輸入。

cues.en: So we add these tools.
cues.zh: 接著加入這些工具。

cues.en: So now instead of the normal two tools, we get four tools.
cues.zh: 因此原本只有兩個工具，現在變成四個。

cues.en: And if you had had a MCP server that had 30 tools, you would get 30 tools out of here.
cues.zh: 如果 MCP 伺服器有三十個工具，這裡就會取得三十個。

cues.en: And in my case, I only have one of these, but we could add multiple.
cues.zh: 目前只設定一個伺服器，但也可以加入多個。

cues.en: In the end, after it has went through and used the Getting Started tool in this case,
cues.zh: 最後，這次使用完 Getting Started 工具後，

cues.en: we need to clean up after our MCP clients.
cues.zh: 需要清理 MCP 用戶端。

cues.en: We could do something more fancy that not spin them up every single time and tear them down every single time.
cues.zh: 可以做得更精緻，避免每次建立、每次拆除。

cues.en: We'll keep them in a cache, using them again and again.
cues.zh: 例如放在快取中重複使用。

cues.en: But the initial connection and the teardown is not too difficult, so I'm just doing it very simply here.
cues.zh: 不過初始化與關閉並不太麻煩，因此這裡採最簡單做法。

cues.en: But you could begin to cache these MCP client tools.
cues.zh: 有需要可以再快取這些 MCP Client Tools。

cues.en: In this case, we're just disposing them, so we get rid of the client and we sever the
cues.zh: 這裡則直接 Dispose，釋放用戶端並中斷，

cues.en: connection between the server and the client, MCP-wise, because we are done with our answer.
cues.zh: MCP 伺服器與用戶端之間的連線，因為這次回答已經完成。

cues.en: And that is actually everything there is to it.
cues.zh: 實作就是這些。

cues.en: So, as you can see, it's just a different way of making tools, and we need a little GUI in order to do it.
cues.zh: 如你所見，這只是另一種建立工具的方式，另外需要簡單設定介面。

cues.en: But it's quite simple once we have it, because we have this method.
cues.zh: 有了這個方法，實作相當簡單。

cues.en: Behind the scenes, this method is not too difficult either.
cues.zh: 背後的方法本身也不複雜。

cues.en: If you look at it, it essentially just wraps the HTTP client transport options for the
cues.zh: 實際查看，它只是包裝 HTTP Client Transport Options，提供給，

cues.en: model contact protocol, and then it goes in, makes a client, and, say, lists tools async,
cues.zh: Model Context Protocol，接著建立 Client，呼叫 ListToolsAsync，

cues.en: and then it just casts them as AI tools.
cues.zh: 再把工具轉成 AITool。

cues.en: So, you don't need to use Agent Framework Toolkit to do this.
cues.zh: 所以不一定要用 Agent Framework Toolkit。

cues.en: You can grab the MCP model contact protocol client yourself here from the official NuGet
cues.zh: 也可以直接使用官方 NuGet 套件中的 Model Context Protocol 用戶端，

cues.en: package, but I'm just doing it for you, so you don't need to do it yourself.
cues.zh: 我只是先封裝好，讓你不必自己處理。

cues.en: So, that is everything for this video.
cues.zh: 這支影片的內容就是這些。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
